description: This source file defines a static class `CatalogInstruments` that creates and manages various performance and operational metrics (counters and gauges) related to the Orleans runtime catalog, such as activation lifecycle events and collections. It also provides methods to observe certain metrics.

classes.name: CatalogInstruments
classes.description: A static class that encapsulates the creation and registration of various performance counters and gauges for tracking activation metrics within the Orleans runtime catalog.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaCollection
methods.description: Records a shutdown event via collection by incrementing the ActivationShutdown counter with a specified 'via' reason.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaDeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Records a shutdown event via deactivate on idle.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaMigration
methods.description: Records a shutdown event via migration.

methods.name: ActivationShutdownViaDeactivateStuckActivation
methods.description: Records a shutdown event via deactivating a stuck activation.

methods.name: RegisterActivationCountObserve
methods.description: Registers an observer for the ActivationCount gauge.

methods.name: RegisterActivationWorkingSetObserve
methods.description: Registers an observer for the ActivationWorkingSet gauge.
